name: Sparkle

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 450 px wide at s = 1

params.name: color
params.note: sparkle colour; a darker edge is added

params.name: anim
params.note: twinkle = each sparkle pulses in turn

params.name: popIn
params.note: springs in over the first 10 frames
